relations_to.summary: Fiji holds the rotating chair of the Melanesian Spearhead Group for two years from June 2025 and hosted the 23rd Leaders' Summit in Suva. In 2023 Rabuka backed the West Papuan ULMWP's bid for full MSG membership, a point of friction with Indonesia.

sources.title: Fiji takes chairmanship of the Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG)
Rabuka backs call for West Papuan independence group to fully join MSG

relations_to.summary: Founding member of the Melanesian Spearhead Group with Papua New Guinea and Solomon Islands; the Agreed Principles were signed in Port Vila on 14 March 1988. The bloc later admitted the FLNKS (1989) and Fiji (1996); Indonesia is an associate member since 2015.

sources.title: MSG leaders push for strong stance on New Caledonia at Tonga summit
